layers.name: Measured points
layers.source: Sentinel-2 L2A band ratios and SRTM terrain, per training point
layers.note: 50 points the model was fitted on. Bands and terrain are measured; the site labels are public MOIL mine locations.

layers.name: Prospectivity surface
layers.source: Ordinary kriging over the fitted model (track-a-gbt-lomo-v1)
layers.note: 1710 cells at 0.05 degrees. A surface prospectivity score, not a grade and not a reserve (PRD 2.4).

layers.name: Kriging uncertainty
layers.source: Kriging standard deviation for the same cells
layers.note: Where the surface is least constrained by a measurement. Shown because a score without its spread is not a result.
